name: Valkyrie TLR

origin.basis: Kenda Rubber Industrial Co. won a 2017 Taiwan Excellence award for the Valkyrie (K1160X).

manufacturing.basis: Official pages do not state the factory; China listings describe it as imported from Taiwan (seller wording).

positioning: Kenda's lightweight tubeless-ready road race tire with the R3C compound.
weight_basis: Kenda US shop weights for 28 and 30 mm.

wet_notes.summary: Kenda's shop claims superior wet and dry grip.

availability.note: Sold by Kenda's US web shop and by Tmall retailers in mainland China; European availability not verified in this pass.

price_observations.conditions: Official shop sale price on 2026-11-01 (compare-at US$95.95); one tire; US shipping and tax at checkout.

price_observations.market: 泓易创辉运动户外专营店 (Tmall retailer)
price_observations.conditions: Retailer list price for one 28C tubeless tire before discounts; coupon price CNY 257.

caveats: Hookless compatibility and maximum pressure are not stated by Kenda.
